topic: Pro-Palestinian student march (Gaza war) in central London on the third anniversary of the 7 October attacks, organised by the University of London Coalition
scale: around 300 students expected (BBC); strict Met Police conditions (Metro)
quote1: The Metropolitan Police is calling on the organisers of a pro-Palestinian student march planned to take place on the third anniversary of the 7 October attacks on Israel to move the event.
quote2: A pro-Palestine student march in central London has been given strict conditions to prevent disruption.
